meta.name: correlate-ioc
meta.description: Check for existing SIEM alerts and case management entries related to IOCs. Use to understand if an indicator has triggered previous alerts or is part of ongoing investigations. Takes IOC list and returns related alerts and cases.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询威胁情报关联的告警与案件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在安全运营中快速关联IOC的历史告警和案件。
copy.tagline_en: Check SIEM alerts and cases linked to IOCs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to correlate IOCs with existing alerts and cases in security operations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能检查指定的威胁指标（如IP、域名）是否在之前触发了安全警报或关联的案例，并返回关联的警报信息和案例摘要。
howto.when: 当用户提供威胁指标列表（如IP、域名）给Claude时触发；也可以指定时间范围或案例过滤器。

say.text: 检查这个IP 198.51.100.10是否有关联的警报？
say.note: 返回该IP的SIEM警报和案例摘要。

say.text: 看看域名evil-domain.com是否出现在近期案例中？
say.note: 返回与该域名相关的案例。

say.text: 查询过去24小时内哪些警报与这些IOC相关？
say.note: 返回时间范围内的警报详情。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can check whether specified threat indicators (e.g., IPs, domains) have triggered previous SIEM alerts or are part of related cases, and return summaries of alerts and cases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a list of threat indicators (e.g., IPs, domains) to Claude; optionally, a time range or case filter can be specified.

say_en.text: Check if IP 198.51.100.10 has any related alerts?
say_en.note: Returns SIEM alerts and case summaries for that IP.

say_en.text: See if domain evil-domain.com appears in recent cases?
say_en.note: Returns cases related to that domain.

say_en.text: Query alerts related to these IOCs in the last 24 hours?
say_en.note: Returns alerts within the time range.
